title: Pocketwire Business Profile Seller Response Credit on Chargeback Fees
content:
**Rule of the claims desk.** The seller response credit on a Pocketwire Business Profile chargeback fee is 8.00 dollars when the seller responded to that claim with signature-on-delivery proof no later than the tier's seller response window in calendar days after the claim opened, 5.00 dollars when the seller instead responded with tracking within that window, and nothing when the seller gave neither response in time.

The claim is the buyer claim opened on the chargeback's sale; the timing is the number of calendar days from the claim's opened date to the date of the seller's response recorded on it (the most recent response recorded on that claim).

| Seller's response on the claim | Dated within the window | Seller response credit |
|---|---|---|
| signature-on-delivery proof | yes | USD 8.00 |
| tracking (no signature proof) | yes | USD 5.00 |
| signature proof or tracking | no | none |
| refund, acceptance or no response | — | none |

## The window in figures

| | Starter | Essentials | Growth | Pro | Premier | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Seller response window (calendar days after the claim opened) | 10 | 10 | 10 | 14 | 14 | 20 |

Columns are the tiers Pocketwire Business Starter to Pocketwire Business Enterprise.

**Boundary days (hypothetical, Pocketwire Business Pro, claim opened on the 3rd).** Signature proof recorded on the 17th (14 days): USD 8.00. Signature proof recorded on the 18th (15 days): none.
